# 2614 African Braiding Salon

> Boho knotless braiding based in Round Rock, Texas. Small, neat knotless and boho braids with clean parts and smooth, painless roots. Braiding hair is included on regular knotless, we keep the colors you want on hand, and we are quick in the chair without rushing your parts.

- Nearby areas: Round Rock, Austin, Pflugerville, Georgetown, Hutto, Cedar Park
- Google rating: 4.8 from 44 reviews

## Services
- Boho knotless braids: Knotless braids with soft curly pieces left out through the length. Our signature look, from $260.
- Knotless, box & micro braids: Lightweight braids with flat roots and crisp parts. Regular knotless from $230, hair included.
- French curl & curly boho: Curly-ended braids with full, bouncy curls that move. French curl from $250.
- Twists & soft locs: Senegalese, passion and island twists, plus soft locs and boho soft locs.
- Stitch braids & cornrows: Stitch braids, cornrows, Fulani and lemonade braids, straight back or into buns.
- Locs & natural hair: Retwists and loc styles that keep your locs neat, plus braid downs and sew-ins.

## About
2614 African Braiding Salon is a bright private suite inside the salon suites on the I-35 frontage road in Round Rock: round black mirrors, a hooded dryer, and a wall of colorful butterflies, many with a client's name written on them, that you will want a picture in front of. Boho knotless braids are what we are known for, in every color from burgundy and honey to copper and mint. Clients ask for Indira and Fancy by name, and some drive up to two hours each way because the parts are that clean and the braids come out exactly the way they asked. Braiding hair is included on regular knotless, and for boho you can bring your curly hair or buy it from us. Book on Booksy or call, and follow the latest installs on Instagram and TikTok.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Is the braiding hair included?
  A: Braiding hair is included on regular knotless. For boho knotless, the curly hair is not included: bring your own or buy it from us. Call first if you need a specific color so we can check it is in stock.
- Q: How much do braids cost?
  A: Our Booksy menu lists starting prices, for example regular knotless from $230, boho knotless from $260, box braids from $220 and stitch braids from $150. Size and length change the final price.
- Q: How do I book, and is there a deposit?
  A: Book on Booksy or call (512) 848-0018. A 10% non-refundable deposit is required for cancellations on all services.
- Q: How do I pay the balance?
  A: The remaining balance is paid by cash, Zelle, Cash App (plus fee) or Apple Pay. We do not take cards in the suite, so plan ahead.
- Q: How should I prep my hair?
  A: Come with your hair shampooed and blown out from root to end, unless you added a wash and blow-out to your booking. Use a heat protectant and moisturize the length, but keep product off the roots.
- Q: Will it hurt? I'm tender headed.
  A: Clients with tender heads tell us their knotless braids came out with no pain at all. Let us know when you sit down and we will go easy.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: We are open every day, generally 8 AM to 8 PM and Sundays from 9 AM. Open times can change, so Booksy always shows the live availability.
- Q: How do I find the suite?
  A: We are at 3021 S I-35 Frontage Rd, Suite 260, Room 31, Round Rock, TX 78664, inside the salon suite building. Head to Suite 260 and look for Room 31.
